title: Coin Change
statement_md:
You are given an integer array `coins` representing coins of different denominations and an integer `amount` representing a total amount of money.

Return the fewest number of coins that you need to make up that amount. If that amount of money cannot be made up by any combination of the coins, return -1.

You may assume that you have an infinite number of each kind of coin.

hints.text: Bottom-up Dynamic Programming: let `dp[i]` be minimum coins to make amount `i`.
For each coin, update `dp[i] = min(dp[i], dp[i - coin] + 1)`. If `dp[amount] == inf` return -1.

editorial_md:
### Optimal Approach: Dynamic Programming

Build solutions iteratively from $1$ up to `amount`. For each sub-amount $a$, test each coin $c$.

- Time Complexity: $O(\text{amount} \times \text{len(coins)})$
- Space Complexity: $O(\text{amount})$
